operations.description: Clears the cache for a project.

operations.description: Delete a checkout key.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME]  [PATH] project checkout key [PARAMS] fingerprint project username [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Deletes the environment variable named ':name'
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME]  [PATH] project envvar [PARAMS] name project username [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Provides information about the signed in user.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] me [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] user

operations.description: Build summary for each of the last 30 builds for a single git repo.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] project [PARAMS] filter limit offset project username [SCHEMA] build builds lifecycle previous

operations.description: Lists checkout keys.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] project checkout key [PARAMS] project username [SCHEMA] key keys

operations.description: Get a checkout key.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] project checkout key [PARAMS] fingerprint project username [SCHEMA] key

operations.description: Lists the environment variables for :project
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] project envvar [PARAMS] project username [SCHEMA] envvar envvars

operations.description: Gets the hidden value of environment variable :name
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] project envvar [PARAMS] name project username [SCHEMA] envvar

operations.description:
Full details for a single build. The response includes all of the fields from the build summary.
This is also the payload for the [notification webhooks](/docs/configuration/#notify), in which case this object is the value to a key named 'payload'.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] project [PARAMS] build num project username [SCHEMA] 1 build commit detail details previous sha user

operations.description: List the artifacts produced by a given build.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] project artifacts [PARAMS] build num project username [SCHEMA] artifact artifacts

operations.description:
Provides test metadata for a build
Note: [Learn how to set up your builds to collect test metadata](https://circleci.com/docs/test-metadata/)
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] project tests [PARAMS] build num project username [SCHEMA] tests

operations.description: List of all the projects you're following on CircleCI, with build information organized by branch.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] projects [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] aws null or project projects scope string

operations.description: Build summary for each of the last 30 recent builds, ordered by build_num.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] recent builds [PARAMS] limit offset [SCHEMA] build builds lifecycle previous

operations.description: Triggers a new build, returns a summary of the build.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] project [PARAMS] project username [SCHEMA] 1 build outcome parallel parameters revision sha summary tag

operations.description:
Creates a new checkout key.
Only usable with a user API token.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] project checkout key [PARAMS] project username [SCHEMA] key

operations.description: Creates a new environment variable
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] project envvar [PARAMS] project username [SCHEMA] envvar

operations.description: Create an ssh key used to access external systems that require SSH key-based authentication
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] project ssh key [PARAMS] content project type username [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Triggers a new build, returns a summary of the build.
Optional build parameters can be set using an experimental API.

Note: For more about build parameters, read about [using parameterized builds](https://circleci.com/docs/parameterized-builds/)
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] project tree [PARAMS] branch project username [SCHEMA] build lifecycle parallel parameters previous revision

operations.description: Cancels the build, returns a summary of the build.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] project cancel [PARAMS] build num project username [SCHEMA] build lifecycle previous

operations.description: Retries the build, returns a summary of the new build.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] project retry [PARAMS] build num project username [SCHEMA] build lifecycle previous
